razonamiento: Merged visual and spoken readings for the Levels Beyond Reach Engine video processing pipeline. The whiteboard features an ingestion and AI processing workflow starting at S3, orchestrated by Step Functions across MediaConvert, Rekognition, and Transcribe -> Comprehend, all writing metadata into DynamoDB. Reach Engine is drawn as a container holding EC2 and EKS, connected to DynamoDB. The narration details that a user uploads the video file to S3 (adding UserConsumerWeb as a spoken node) and that Step Functions also triggers Lambdas to store metadata in DynamoDB (adding Lambda as a spoken node). Browser is dropped as it is only a casual mention without flows. The undirected visual line between the Reach Engine container and DynamoDB is routed as data ingestion from DynamoDB into both EC2 and EKS based on the spoken flow 'pump that into our orchestration engine'.
